_meta.why_not_gate_eligible: TWO independent disqualifiers, either one sufficient: (1) LINES ONLY — no prices visible, and R1 forbids inventing one; (2) ingested post-slate, so any derived play is result-contaminated. Even a full CSV with real prices would not make THIS board gate-eligible — it would be shadow-priced like 7/24.
_meta.source: Taco screenshot of a multi-book strikeout table (DraftKings / FanDuel / BetMGM / BetRivers / Caesars), transcribed by eye 2026-07-25.
_meta.transcription_risk: HIGH — read from an image, the least reliable extraction path this project uses. Cross-check: the board contains exactly 27 arms, which equals the 30 slate starters minus PHI TBD, MIN TBD, and Mason Barnett (no log). That match is evidence the row set is right; it is NOT evidence the numbers in each cell are right.
_meta.column_semantics_WARNING: The five book columns are almost certainly NOT five quotes on the same bet. Mean signed displacement (E[K] - line): DK -1.44, FD -1.23, CZR -1.27, MGM -0.61, BR -0.11. A real main line sits near the true mean, so BR is the only column behaving like one (MAE 0.49). DK/FD/CZR post >=7.5 K lines on Andre Pallante (16.9 K%), Bryce Elder (19.8 K%) and Tanner Bibee (19.0 K%) — no book prices a 16.9 K% starter at 8.5. Read those columns as an ALT-LINE LADDER until the source proves otherwise.
_meta.near_miss: Ingesting this board naively would have manufactured 11 fake R5-level UNDER edges (Pallante -4.36, Burke -3.73, Elder -3.64 ...) purely by comparing projections against alt lines. Recorded so the failure mode is on the record even though it did not happen.
_meta.r1_compliance: All prices null. Nothing inferred, nothing guessed.

_meta.TIMING_CORRECTION_2: SECOND correction, this one from authoritative data rather than a clock. Two statsapi endpoints agree the real time at ingestion was ~22:10Z on 7/25: KC@DET Final, 4 games In Progress, 10 Pre-Game/Warmup. The container clock reads ~4h FAST (said 02:04Z on 7/26) and covers.com was serving a stale 7/24 page whose 'finals' were byte-identical to the 7/24 results already in results.csv — that page was NOT recorded as 7/25 data.
_meta.contamination_is_PARTIAL_not_total: Accurate ruling: arms in KC@DET (Wacha, Mize) are result-contaminated; arms in AZ@WSH, LAA@SF, TOR@BOS, SD@MIA (Griffin, Ray, Cease, Gray, Perez, Sears, Bratt) were in-progress at ingestion and are contaminated. The other 16 arms were in games that had not started. HOWEVER: Taco's screenshot capture time is unknown and unverifiable, and eyeball transcription of an image is this project's least reliable extraction path. Board stays SHADOW-ONLY in full. Recording the partial truth so the record is accurate, not so the rule is loosened.
